name: Hollow Gloam

abilities.name: Glacial Aura
abilities.description: At the end of each of the hollow gloam's turns, each creature within 5 feet of the hollow gloam takes 13 (3d8) cold damage.

abilities.name: Cold Absorption
abilities.description: Whenever the hollow gloam is subjected to cold damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the cold damage dealt.

abilities.name: Siege Monster
abilities.description: The hollow gloam deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hollow gloam makes two Fist attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Frost Follow-Up.

actions.name: Fist
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) cold damage.

actions.name: Killing Cold (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in a 30-foot cone must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 71 (13d10) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, the target is also deafened until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Frost Follow-Up
actions.description: One creature within 30 feet of the hollow gloam that is deafened must make a DC 17 Strength saving throw, taking 54 (12d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

generation.userConcept: a glacier's heart given legs, trailing a wake of killing cold

clauses.text: trailing a wake of killing cold

generation.cite: composition after Clay Golem / Stone Golem (CR 9-10)

other_edition.lore: When a glacier dies of a wound deep in its face, the last heat it hoarded sometimes calcifies into a walking heart that remembers only the cold it came from and the long, patient urge to give it back to the valley.
